summary: VisionWave filed an 8-K Item 8.01 to disclose a non-binding term sheet for a joint venture to develop a data center in Israel. The registrant would hold a 68% stake in the Joint Company, yielding an effective ~51% project interest via a project company. Consideration is $40M in VisionWave common stock (no cash); share count based on VWAP near closing, subject to Nasdaq shareholder approval. The structure includes lock-up and registration rights. No price per share, premium, or definitive agreement exists; the filing is merely an early-stage intention. This is not a special situation.
